boost_rule: already bath frame; parent-rest boost kernel must be bypassed or explicit u=0 identity
normalization: positive number weights per absorbing target per proper second
gas_source_rule: multiply channel weights by declared target abundance X_i (per fixed reference) or target proper density n_i, never both
primary_charge_and_binding_rule: same event counts define target charge increment+1, free electron increment+1 and chi*count binding supply; nuclear isotope mapping remains explicit
electron_kinetic_rule: retain as primary nonthermal supply until actual deposition admitted; no duplicate photoheat
finite_support: chi<=photon<=50000eV; K=photon-chi; high photon absorption remains unknown
tail_policy: low/high FS-energy tails retained with count+energy; no implicit zero/renormalization
independent_C9: parent review/provider_c9 in progress at packet close
